title: A Home Far Away
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In the United States in winter 1990, Alan, a sickly teenager whose devout parents blame his illness on sin and who was abused by a priest as a child, meets Hayden, a drifter and cook with a violent family past. Hayden offers him escape, and the two run away together on a road trip shadowed by crime, trauma and the law. A single-volume boys' love tragedy.
life_message: Being truly accepted by another person can matter more than the home and faith one was raised in, even at great cost.

winners_losers: Alan and Hayden find each other but the story ends in tragedy; abusive clergy and judgmental parents lose sympathy; acceptance and escape get it.
